name: Dot Plot Operator
description: Dot Plot intended for Upstream Kinase Analysis results

properties.name: ColorLimitAutomatic
properties.description: Auto-set color limits - if true, the ColorLowerLimit and ColorUpperLimit parameters are ignored. If data contains both - and + values, the min and max is used as limits. If not, the limits are set to the 0.2 and 0.8 quantiles.

properties.name: ColorLowerLimit
properties.description: Lower limit for mapping to the color scale of the dots

properties.name: ColorUpperLimit
properties.description: Upper limit for mapping to the color scale of the dots

properties.name: ColorPalette
properties.description: Color palette for the dots; white is always at 0

properties.name: SizeLimitAutomatic
properties.description: Automatically determine upper size limit based on 0.75 quantiles. If true, the SizeLowerLimit and SizeUpperLimit parameters will be ignored.

properties.name: SizeLowerLimit
properties.description: Lower limit for mapping to the size scale of the dots

properties.name: SizeUpperLimit
properties.description: Upper limit for mapping to the size scale of the dots

properties.name: Layout
properties.description: Layout of the panels in the dotplot

properties.name: PlotSize
properties.description: Long side length of the plot

properties.name: LabelFontSize
properties.description: Font size for the dot labels (e.g. kinase names) and the legend text

properties.name: ComparisonFontsize
properties.description: Font size for the comparison labels (crosstab columns)

properties.name: GroupFontsize
properties.description: Font size for the group labels, e.g. kinase families (crosstab rows)
